result.stdout:
Description:
  An MCP server that exposes Roslyn and MSBuild to agents.

Usage:
  Roslynaut [options]

Options:
  --protocol <http|sse|stdio>                     The transport that carries MCP. [default: stdio]
  --enable-tools <tool>                           Serve only these tools.
  --disable-tools <tool>                          Leave these tools out, also when --enable-tools names them.
  --no-instructions                               Leave out the server instructions, which tell agents which tool to use for what.
  --tool-descriptions <caveman|full|none|short>   The tools' descriptions in the tools' schemas: full, short (the first sentence), caveman (terse, keeping identifiers and keywords) or none, for less of agents' context; explain_tool gives them in full. [default: full]
  --field-descriptions <caveman|full|none|short>  The parameters' descriptions in the tools' schemas: full, short (the first sentence), caveman (terse, keeping identifiers and keywords) or none, for less of agents' context; explain_tool gives them in full. [default: full]
  --install <agent>                               Register the server with this agent for all projects, and exit. Claude Code also gets a hook, and OpenCode a plugin, that suggests its tools when the agent reads or greps C# files.
  --no-hooks                                      With --install, register the server alone: Claude Code gets no hooks and OpenCode no plugin, and those of an earlier installation are removed.
  --uninstall <agent>                             Remove the server and its hook or plugin from this agent, as before uninstalling the tool, and exit.
  -?, -h, --help                                  Show help and usage information
  --version                                       Show version information
